column3: Application for a Market Stall Permit
For the Harbour Market and the Saturday Square Market
Before you start. Please write in capital letters using black ink. Incomplete applications will be returned to the applicant without being assessed.
Complete sections A, B and C.
Attach a copy of your identity document and, for food stalls, your food hygiene certificate.
Return the form to the Markets and Trading Office or post it to the address on page 2.
B1. Which market do you wish to trade at?
B2. What will you sell? Tick all that apply.

C1. Have you held a market permit in Port Selwyn before?
If yes, permit number and year
C2. Has a permit of yours ever been suspended or withdrawn?

I declare that the information given on this form is true and complete. I understand that a permit may be withdrawn if any of this information is found to be false. I agree to follow the market regulations and the instructions of the market supervisors.

Applications are normally decided within fifteen working days. Fees are payable monthly in advance, and the first payment is due before the permit is issued. Send the completed form to: Markets and Trading Office, 1 Quay Street, Port Selwyn PS1 4AA.
